Apply a bit of moisture to the tragus (front part of your ear).
Clip the earpiece to your left ear, cable over and behind the ear.
Turn it on and slowly increase intensity until you feel a light, pleasant tingling.
Use it for 15–60 minutes per session, ideally daily. 
Best routine:
